name: After § 40
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 40a. Emphasises the urgent necessity to uphold the rights of pregnant women, ensuring that they receive comprehensive support for their health, safety and dignity that includes guaranteed access to maternal healthcare services, availability of childcare facilities such as nurseries, and the establishment of fair workplace policies that protect their well-being, income and career advancement;
